newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June single-family home sales rose 6.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June single-family home sales rose 6.1 pct.

text.p: U.S. Commerce Department reported sales of new single-family homes, seasonally adjusted, with percent changes from prior month (numbers in 1,000s).
Total June sales of single-family homes rose 11.9 percent from an annualized rate of 732,000 units a year ago.
Note-Actual number of new single-family units sold is not seasonally adjusted.
Wall Street economists forecast June single-family home sales at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 818,000 units.
The department also revised monthly percent changes of total sales, seasonally adjusted, from prior months as follows:
The annualized sales rate for March was revised to 825,000 units from 838,000.
Number of Months: June May-(Prev) Apr-(Prev)
The supply of homes for sale dipped to 4.2 months' worth in June, its lowest reading since 4.1 months' worth in July 1971, the department said.
The end-of-month inventory of homes declined to 282,000 units in June, its lowest level since 278,000 in July 1993.
